recipes.name: Thai Red Curry Noodle Soup with Crispy Tofu
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the tofu and cook until golden on most sides, about 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, heat some more oil in a large pot over high heat. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes, stirring often.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 more minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, coconut milk, soy sauce, sambal (if using), and bell pepper. Stir to combine, then partially cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and bok choy and simmer for 3 minutes.**
Divide the soup among bowls. Top with the tofu and any desired toppings, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If you're vegan, be sure to check the ingredient list of the curry paste to make sure it is free from fish sauce. ** If you don't have noodles that cook within 3 minutes, cook them in a separate saucepan first, then add them to the coconut broth at the end.

Storage This soup is best enjoyed immediately. Otherwise, store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days. Ideally, store the noodles, tofu, and broth separately, and combine only when ready to enjoy.
